cat > t.py <<'PYEOF'
import bpy, time, json, urllib.request, os
out = []
def p(*a): out.append(" ".join(str(x) for x in a))
# 1) blendkit login state
key = ""
for name, ad in bpy.context.preferences.addons.items():
    if "blenderkit" in name.lower() or "blendkit" in name.lower():
        pr = ad.preferences
        key = getattr(pr, "api_key", "") or ""
        p("addon:", name, "| api_key set:", bool(key), "len", len(key))
if not key: p("addon prefs: no api key found")
# 2) search API with key
for q in ["sedan car", "restaurant table"]:
    try:
        url = "https://www.blendkit.com/api/v1/search/?query=" + urllib.parse.quote(q + " asset_type:model") + "&page_size=5"
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key} if key else {})
        d = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30))
        p("search", repr(q), "count", d.get("count"))
        for r in d.get("results", [])[:5]:
            p("  -", r.get("name"), "| free:", r.get("isFree"), "| canDownload:", r.get("canDownload"), "| license:", r.get("license"))
    except Exception as e:
        p("search error", q, e)
# 3) render tests 1080x1920
sc = bpy.context.scene
sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y, sc.render.resolution_percentage = 1080, 1920, 100
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_monkey_add(location=(1.6, 0, 0.6)); bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=20, location=(0, 0, -1))
for eng in ["BLENDER_EEVEE", "BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT"]:
    try: sc.render.engine = eng; break
    except Exception: pass
t = time.time(); sc.render.filepath = "/tmp/eevee.png"; bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True); p("EEVEE", sc.render.engine, "1080x1920:", round(time.time() - t, 2), "s")
sc.render.engine = "CYCLES"
cp = bpy.context.preferences.addons["cycles"].preferences
try:
    cp.compute_device_type = "METAL"; cp.get_devices()
    for d in cp.devices: d.use = True
    sc.cycles.device = "GPU"; p("cycles devices:", [d.name for d in cp.devices])
except Exception as e: p("metal err", e)
sc.cycles.samples = 64; sc.cycles.use_denoising = True
t = time.time(); sc.render.filepath = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "frame.png"); bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True); p("CYCLES GPU 64spp 1080x1920:", round(time.time() - t, 2), "s")
open(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "result.txt"), "w").write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
PYEOF

/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P t.py > blender.log 2>&1; echo '--- log tail' >> result.txt; grep -v 'blendkit:' blender.log | tail -8 >> result.txt; [ -f frame.png ] || cp /tmp/eevee.png frame.png
